string-array.name: quotes
string-array.item: “Starve your distractions, feed your focus.”\n— Unknown
“The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus.”\n— Bruce Lee
“Where focus goes, energy flows.”\n— Tony Robbins
“You can do anything, but not everything.”\n— David Allen
“It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.”\n— Seneca
“Concentrate all your thoughts upon the work at hand. The sun’s rays do not burn until brought to a focus.”\n— Alexander Graham Bell
“The key is not to prioritize what’s on your schedule, but to schedule your priorities.”\n— Stephen Covey
“What you stay focused on will grow.”\n— Roy T. Bennett
“Almost everything will work again if you unplug it for a few minutes, including you.”\n— Anne Lamott
“Lack of direction, not lack of time, is the problem. We all have twenty-four hour days.”\n— Zig Ziglar
“Distraction is the enemy of vision.”\n— Unknown
“The shorter way to do many things is to do only one thing at a time.”\n— Mozart
“Be where you are; otherwise you will miss your life.”\n— Buddha
“Your phone has no idea how much your time is worth. You do.”\n— Unknown
“Focus on being productive instead of busy.”\n— Tim Ferriss
“Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity.”\n— Simone Weil
“The scroll never ends. Your day does.”\n— Unknown
